observations.why: The act of switching to a novel database technology appeals to novelty and self-direction as the good being pursued.
Performance gain and cost reduction appeal to achievement and mastery as the goods; the 10x multiplier intensifies the achievement framing.
The arrow notation frames the migration as a directional move toward novelty, appealing to change as the good.
Quantified performance gain appeals to achievement and capability mastery as the goods.
Setting a fixed timeline appeals to stability and planning — conservation of order — as the good.
